label: node join
type: the node-initiated way to grow a cluster: an unprovisioned node joins itself to a named cluster. Has the same effect as node addition, requires a rebalance, and is NOT supported by the CLI - UI and REST only.
evidence: As well as supporting a cluster's adding a node to itself, Couchbase Server also supports a node's joining itself to a cluster.
Note also, however, that a node _cannot_ join itself to a cluster if the node has already been provisioned.
Node-join is not supported by the CLI.
note: The `hasEquivalentEffectAs` pair (addition/join) plus one asymmetry the reference tree does not carry: join has no CLI. Round 26 found surface-availability asymmetries like this repeatedly - the same operation offered by a different subset of UI/CLI/REST - and they are only ever stated on the procedure page, because a concept has no surface.
